testRuns.question: What is the refund window for a defective product?

response.answer: The refund window for a defective product is not limited to 30 days; customers are entitled to a full refund regardless of the 30-day window, provided that the defective items are reported within 14 days of delivery for expedited processing.

citations.quote: If a product arrives defective, damaged, or dead on arrival (DOA), customers are entitled to a full refund regardless of the 30-day window. In these cases, we also cover the cost of return shipping. Defective items should be reported within 14 days of delivery for expedited processing.

Section 1: Refund and Returns Policy
Our company offers a standard refund window of 30 days from the date of purchase.
Customers must provide a valid receipt or order confirmation number to be eligible.
Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days and are credited back to the
original payment method used at checkout.
If a product arrives defective, damaged, or dead on arrival (DOA), customers are
entitled to a full refund regardless of the 30-day window. In these cases, we also
cover the cost of return shipping. Defective items should be reported within 14
days of delivery for expedited processing.
Digital products, gift cards, and clearance items marked "final sale" are not
eligible for refunds under any circumstances.

Digital products, gift cards, and clearance items marked "final sale" are not
eligible for refunds under any circumstances.
The refund policy reference code for internal tracking is RFD-2024-STD.

Section 2: Customer Support Hours
Our headquarters is located in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. The customer support team
operates Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pakistan Standard Time.
We are closed on all major public holidays, including Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha,
and Pakistan Independence Day (August 14th).
For urgent issues outside business hours, customers can submit a ticket through
the online portal, and a team member will respond within 24 hours on the next
business day.
The support team can be reached at support@examplecompany.com or by phone at
the number listed on our contact page. Average first-response time during
business hours is under 2 hours.

Section 3: Engineering Deployment Process
The engineering team uses a monorepo structure with separate packages for the
frontend application, backend API services, and shared utility libraries.
All code changes go through a mandatory pull request review process before
merging into the main branch. At least one approval is required from a senior
engineer before a PR can be merged.
Every deployment passes through a staging environment first, where automated
integration tests run against a production-like dataset. Only after staging
tests pass does a change get promoted to production via the CI/CD pipeline.
Rollbacks can be triggered manually within 10 minutes if a production issue
is detected, using the deployment dashboard's one-click revert feature.

Section 4: Subscription Pricing Tiers
We offer three subscription tiers: Basic, Pro, and Enterprise.
The Basic tier is priced at $9.99 per month and includes access to core features
with a limit of 5 projects and 2 team members.
The Pro tier is priced at $29.99 per month and includes unlimited projects, up
to 10 team members, and priority email support.
The Enterprise tier is custom-priced based on organization size and includes
dedicated account management, a 99.9% uptime SLA, and single sign-on (SSO)
integration. Enterprise customers must contact sales directly for a quote.
Annual billing is available on all tiers at a 15% discount compared to monthly
billing.
